snippet.title: Ritter & Rotwein Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2994200/Ritter__Rotwein/ 

Prove yourself as a drunken ragdoll knight. Fame and glory belong to those who reach the finish line in time and unscathed. Master physics-based combat equipped with authentic late medieval weapons, magnificent armor, and a bottle of wine.

We are excited to finally announce the release of our first title.
Even though there were plenty of rough edges and stumbling blocks along the way, we are extremely proud of what we’ve achieved and hope you like it.
